_README: Hand-authored ANALYSIS specs (sub-step 3c). Each entry is one analysis — a comparison/finding OVER conditions (leaderboard, hypothesis test, sweep, ...). The generator (scripts/generate_post_run_report.py) validates these, attaches provenance, and emits results/analyses-manifest.json (+ .md). HYBRID authoring: the machine-fillable keys (analysis_id, type, conditions_compared, output_path) are authored here; the human-authored fields (outcome, hypothesis_refs, preregistered, deviations, predicted_outcome, tie_set, paper_section, working_notes_obs) may stay null until a human writes the finding + preregistration linkage, per the schema's lenient back-fill. Set manually_verified_at when a human has authored/verified a row. Schema: docs/manifest-schemas/analyses-manifest.schema.json.

analyses._note: The N=1 single-pass baseline leaderboard at 384px (the cross-architecture model x modality x thinking x temperature matrix). FINDING (authored 2026-06-03, REVISED 2026-06-03 for E57 genuine-Pro replace): tie_set + outcome from a round-robin tile-swap permutation (replicate-mean per-tile, 10k perms, seed 42, two-sided) + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q=0.05) + greedy-clique tiering at the 20 m headline buffer -> 7 tiers (120/153 pairs significant); Tier 1 (tie_set) = the SINGLE leader pro-text-high-t-0-0 (genuine Pro, HIGH thinking, T=0.0; F1 0.804), significantly clear of the Tier-2 trio of other Pro-text passes. The four anti-diagonal Pro cells are the genuine-Pro re-run (n1-pro-rerun-384), REPLACING the Flash-misdispatched n1-outstanding cells of the same corners (E57); the prior board's two-member tie (pro-text-medium-t-0-0 0.763 + pro-text-high-t-0-7 0.745) was computed before this replace and is superseded. Result artefacts: results/paper-eval/n1/384px-14buf-mcc/tiering/tiering_20m.{json,md}; script: scripts/n1_baseline_leaderboard_tiering.py. This single-pass board is the baseline comparator the consensus (H3) and proposer-verifier (H2) architectures are measured against. See docs/methodology/n1-baseline-matrix.md and planning/leaderboard-construction-plan.md.
analyses.predicted_outcome: Preregistered directions come from earlier Gemini-3-Flash / 512 px phases (this board is Gemini 3 at 384 px): H6 (Phase 4, the only untested confirmatory hypothesis) expected the stronger Pro model to transfer/match-or-exceed Flash; H7 (Phase 2b) found T=0.0 optimal for both tracks; H1 (Phase 2a) planned a text-only vs image-using contrast without a committed directional winner. Board result (post-E57, genuine Pro): H6 holds strongly and uniformly -- the top five cells are all genuine Pro, every Pro-text cell beats the best Flash cell (flash-image-minimal-t-0-0, F1 0.600), and the genuine Pro-image cells match Flash on F1 while dominating MCC; the earlier apparent 'Flash beats weak Pro' (the pre-E57 board had Flash image-MINIMAL 0.59-0.60 above 'Pro' configs at 0.42-0.53) was an ARTEFACT of the Flash-misdispatched anti-diagonal -- those four cells were Flash, not Pro (E57), and genuine Pro at the same corners scores 0.59-0.80. H7's T=0.0 advantage now appears at the apex (the sole Tier-1 leader is T=0.0) though Tier 2 mixes T=0.0 and T=0.7 indistinguishably. H1 resolves metric-dependently -- text wins F1@20 m localisation (the top four cells are all text) while image wins MCC tile-discrimination (pro-image-medium-t-0-7, MCC +0.913).
analyses.outcome: At the preregistered 20 m buffer the best single pass for mound localisation is genuine Gemini 3 Pro text with HIGH thinking at T=0.0 (baseline-pro-text-high-t-0-0, run n1-pro-rerun-384; F1 0.804), the SOLE Tier-1 leader: the round-robin tile-swap permutation (BH-FDR q=0.05; 120/153 pairs significant -> 7 tiers) separates it from every other configuration. It is significantly clear of a Tier-2 trio of mutually-indistinguishable Pro-text passes -- pro-text-medium-t-0-7 (F1 0.764), pro-text-medium-t-0-0 (0.763), pro-text-high-t-0-7 (0.745). The top four cells are all Pro text and the top five all genuine Pro; the text-over-image advantage that recurs throughout the paper holds at matched settings (best Pro text 0.804 vs best Pro image 0.666). The F1 leader is NOT the tile-level discrimination (MCC) leader, however: genuine Pro IMAGE wins MCC -- pro-image-medium-t-0-7 (MCC +0.913, but only 10th on F1) and pro-image-high-t-0-0 (MCC +0.868) -- while Pro text leads F1, so the best single-pass configuration is metric-dependent. This board SUPERSEDES the pre-E57 version (whose Tier 1 was a two-member tie at 0.763/0.745): the four anti-diagonal 'Pro' cells there were Flash misdispatches (E57); re-dispatched as genuine Pro they score 0.59-0.80, and pro-text-high-t-0-0 takes the outright lead.
